note: Carousel page (55141:14172): the ten Carousel variants (mobile / tablet x layouts) and the full-screen carousel. Item content is the kit's placeholder art (figma/list/assets/placeholder-700.png, FIT, luminosity over Surface Container High).

carousel-mobile-multi.allowedDiffReason: Compose multi-browse for 380px with a 188px preferred item arranges 188 / 122 / 54 (medium = (large + small) / 2, small flexed to fit); the kit draws 188 / 120 / 56, which no Compose arrangement produces. The second and third items differ by 2px.

carousel-mobile-uncontained.allowedDiffReason: The kit fits the cut-off item's art to its visible part (a 72px frame with square right corners); in Compose's uncontained carousel that item is the medium keyline (130.9px) cut by the container edge, so its art is centred in the full item. Silhouettes match; the drift is the art inside the cut item.

carousel-tablet-uncontained.allowedDiffReason: The kit fits the cut-off item's art to its visible part (a 72px frame with square right corners); in Compose's uncontained carousel that item is the medium keyline (138.3px) cut by the container edge, so its art is centred in the full item. Silhouettes match; the drift is the art inside the cut item.

carousel-tablet-hero.allowedDiffReason: Kit slip: the tablet Hero variant is a copy of the multi-browse layout (184 / 184 / 120 / 56, including a medium item hero carousels never have). We render Compose's heroKeylineList for 568px (520 / 40).

carousel-tablet-center-hero.allowedDiffReason: Kit slip: the tablet Center-aligned hero variant is a copy of the multi-browse layout (184 / 184 / 120 / 56, including a medium item hero carousels never have). We render Compose's centred heroKeylineList for 568px (40 / 472 / 40).

carousel-mobile-hero.allowedDiffReason: Placeholder art at a fractional offset inside the item (object-fit centring / aspect-ratio widths): Figma and Chrome resample the image edges differently; item geometry matches exactly.
